verdict.rationale: Retrieval latency is a fair axis for an AI memory engine, but the evidence pack contains no documented latency targets or measured p50/p95 numbers. It has only qualitative 'fast retrieval' wording for session memory and accuracy benchmarks (HotpotQA 87%, ~90%), which measure answer quality, not speed.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see documented retrieval-latency targets or measured numbers (e.g. p50/p95) backing the product's speed claims
